lore.earth_theology.the.prayer.desc: Daily mindfulness and timed prayer practice.
lore.earth_theology.the.sanctum.desc: Arranging altars, candles, and pews to form a consecrated sanctum.
lore.earth_theology.the.scriptures.desc: Transcribing and reciting liturgical texts upon scrolls.
lore.earth_theology.the.offerings.desc: Presenting offerings before the altar to elevate sanctum grace and piety.
lore.earth_theology.the.blessings.desc: Burning incense at the altar to bestow protective blessings on nearby allies.
lore.earth_theology.the.holy_water.desc: Consecrating water at a sanctum altar into graded holy water.
lore.earth_theology.the.exorcism.desc: Using burning censers and holy water to purge undead and cleanse desecration.
lore.earth_theology.the.healing_prayer.d: Channeling piety and holy water through prayer beads to mend wounds and toxins.
lore.earth_theology.the.liturgical_calen: Tracking full and new moon feast cycles for liturgical observances.
lore.earth_theology.the.relics.desc: Crafting reliquaries to enshrine pilgrimage relics and exalt the sanctum.
lore.earth_theology.the.temple.desc: Erecting a temple keystone within an enclosed hall to form a grand temple.
lore.earth_theology.the.ordination.desc: Weaving formal vestments to uphold liturgical duties and extend blessings.
lore.earth_theology.the.revelation.desc: Meditating with incense in a night sanctum to reveal lurking foes and hidden caches.
lore.earth_theology.the.sanctuary_ward.d: Inscribing ward stones and charms fueled by holy water to repel undead and hostiles.
lore.earth_theology.the.pilgrimage.desc: Setting forth from an altar with a pilgrim staff to visit distant landmarks.
lore.earth_theology.the.miracles.desc: Invoking miracles of revival, clear sky, and holy light within a thundering temple.
lore.earth_theology.the.theology_mastery: Culminating theological mastery, elevating consecrated holy water to heirloom grade.
